description: View or modify IRIS system configuration parameters. Actions: 'get' retrieves configuration for a section (config, startup, locale); 'set' modifies parameters (config section only, requires properties object); 'export' returns combined system info and configuration data.

action.description: Action to perform: get, set, or export

properties.description: Key-value pairs of configuration properties to set (required for set action)

section.description: Configuration section (default: config). Used with get and set actions.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

name: iris_config_manage
title: Manage System Configuration
